verdict.rationale: Tavily ships a first-party Crawl endpoint. It is documented as a graph-based traversal that explores hundreds of paths in parallel from a base URL, with built-in extraction, natural-language instructions, and depth control. A Map endpoint for site discovery, plus SDK, CLI and MCP access, support the crawl/subpage part well. The evidence does not document crawling that starts directly from a search result; the user must pass a search-result URL into crawl themselves. Missing for 10: documented search-to-crawl chaining (seeding a crawl from search results), independent or hands-on corroboration of crawl depth and coverage on whole sites.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can crawl subpages or entire sites starting from a search result

citations.quote: Tavily Crawl is a graph-based website traversal tool that can explore hundreds of paths in parallel with built-in extraction and intelligent discovery.
Crawl lets you traverse a website's content starting from a base URL.
Tavily Map traverses websites like a graph and can explore hundreds of paths in parallel with intelligent discovery to generate comprehensive site maps.
